description: TD3 actor for tanh-ADRC attitude NLSEF bandwidths (Cai et al. 2026, Sec. 4)
observation: per channel [error/0.05 rad, integral/0.05 rad s, rate error/0.5 rad/s, angle/0.5 rad], then applied wc scaled to [-1,1]
action: tanh output in [-1,1] mapped linearly to td3.action_range for roll, pitch, yaw
